ja295:1.1: Your body is just like a bull’s,
ja295:1.2: your stretching just like a lion’s,
ja295:1.3: King of beasts, honour be to you,
ja295:2.2: how to praise a good family son,
ja295:2.3: One having a neck like a peacock’s,
ja295:2.4: come down from there, O crow!
ja295:3.1: The jackal is the last of the creatures,
ja295:3.3: The castor oil tree is last of trees,
